strings.CHI_Clamp_Down_Corruption_desc: The inevitable disease of every government, corruption. While things aren't quite as bad as they were during the times of Chiang, the Old Guard's less-than-subtle backroom dealings speak for themselves. Of course, they're not the only perpetrators inside the Yuan, but they're by far the most involved faction. However, the Reformists have been calling on the government to curb the worst excesses of the government for some time now, and their proposal could bring us a few benefits - the extra funds saved from going down the gutters of corruption could certainly come in handy. It certainly won't please the Old Guard, however.

strings.CHI_reformists_hide: Hide all interactions with the Reformists
strings.CHI_Reformists_in_Cabinet_desc: Some have called the Reformists dangerous radicals, most notably the Japanophile Faction in the Yuan. But is it not a bit of radicalism that is sometimes needed in such troubling times? While most of the Reformists are rather young and inexperienced politicians, their unyielding devotion to China could prove useful.
strings.CHI_Reformists_in_Cabinet_trigger_tt_1: Does NOT support Japanophiles in the cabinet
strings.CHI_Reformists_in_Cabinet_trigger_tt_2: Does NOT support the Old Guard in the cabinet

strings.CHI_Reformists_in_Cabinet_trigger_tt_2_N: Does NOT support the Old Guard in the cabinet
strings.CHI_Encourage_Domestic_Consumption_desc: A major challenge for Chinese industries comes in the form of Japanese competition. While most Japanese goods are of lesser interest for the majority of our population, they often prove to be stiff resistance for our new industrial companies in the most important sectors. We can try to help out our companies with concerted advertisement campaigns and some small subsidies to even the playing field.
strings.CHI_Stamp_Out_Overzealous_Nationalists_d: The Reformists are certainly a diverse bunch. What they have in common, however, is their desire for a strong and free China, with some members being particularly... vocal... about their vision. Naturally, this can't stand in a member of the Co-Prosperity Sphere (at least for now). Should we ever feel that the Reformists have grown too influential in the Legislative Body, we can undermine their political power by clamping down on the loudest nationalists.
strings.CHI_Invest_in_Chinese_Companies_desc: Outside of fierce competition from other sphere members, most notably Japan, and lacking expertise in technical and economical subjects, Chinese often companies also have to struggle with a chronic lack of funds and investments. To help accelerate the economic development of China, the Reformists have suggested an extensive investment program spearheaded by the government. It would require quite a substantial amount of funds, but the benefits could possess great potential.
strings.CHI_Invest_in_Chinese_Companies_trigger_: Has at least 300M$ in Liquid Reserves.
National Debt does not exceed Gross Domestic Product.
strings.CHI_Modernisation_Awareness_Campaigns_de: Where there is change and progress, anxious reactionaries and traditionalists follow. In a land such as China, where superstitions dominate the countryside despite our best education efforts, the latter group tends to be quite large. And quite a hindrance for any further attempts at modernisation. The Reformists have suggested a cure for this ailment: extensive campaigns focussed on highlighting the benefits of China's Modernisation and taking the common peoples' concerns. Furthermore, such campaigns could also double as effective nationalist propaganda, while also encouraging wide-spread support and enthusiasm for China's ambitions.

strings.CHI_pro_japan_takeover_desc: We have left the actions of the Pro-Japanese Faction unchecked, while angering them with our anti-Japanese actions. They have gained enough influence within our regime to enforce their demands!

strings.CHI_Tech_GUI_desc: Once one of the world's leaders in science and technology, China has fallen back drastically over the last two centuries. Our Technology is woefully outdated, and our main source of innovation lies in Japan. If we are to become a modern and powerful state again, we will have to find ways to research technologies on our own.
strings.CHI_GUI_Tech_innovation_desc_delay_tt:
Our Innovation determines the ingenuity of our scientists and researchers.
Raising this value to 100% will allow us to increase our technological Self-Sufficiency, thus improving our Research Facilities greatly.
In addition, we will be able to choose a small research bonus in the Production, Construction, or Electronics category.

We can increase our Innovation and our Innovation Gain by completing certain National Foci.
strings.CHI_GUI_Tech_self_sufficiency_tt:
We can increase our Self-Sufficiency when our Innovation reaches 100%. Once our Self-Sufficiency reaches 5, we will no longer need to rely on foreign technological assistance.

strings.CHI_GUI_Edu_tt:
Education is vital for the prosperity and success of any nation. Only a properly educated population can provide the state with a sufficient foundation for scientific research, a competent industry and an efficient administrative apparatus.

China does not possess such a population. The overwhelming majority of our people cannot even read or write, let alone study the higher principles of the arts and the sciences. We must remedy this issue if we want to become more than just Japan's breadbasket.
strings.CHI_GUI_Edu_Modernisation_desc_tt: Our current Progress towards Education Modernisation is {CHI_GUI_edu_modernisation}%.
strings.CHI_GUI_Edu_Modernisation_desc_delay_tt: Our Education Modernisation Progress tracks our advances towards bringing our education up to modern standards. When this value reaches 100%, we will be able to increase our Educational Efficiency, advancing our Academic Base and improving the State of our Education.
strings.CHI_GUI_Edu_Efficiency_tt:
Our Educational Efficiency determines our effectiveness of our educational programmes. We can increase this value when our Education Modernisation Progress reaches 100%, improving our country's Academic Base. Once this value reaches 6, the modernisation of our education will be complete.

Our current Educational Efficiency is: [?edu_efficiency|0Y]
strings.CHI_Remilitarization_category_desc:
In the course of our remiltiarization we will be presented with many choices in our way forward. But it is important to be mindful not only of the Factions within the Legislative Yunan, but also of the Imperial Japanese Army who shall be watching our progress with their hands tightly gripped around their weapons. We cannot let any of these two take notice of our actions.

The current IJA Alert Level is {chi_getijaalert}.
strings.CHI_Prodigal_Son_TT: Send a man to Heqiao and vist an old foe, China has need of him.
strings.CHI_Hiding_Our_Interests_Category_desc: Under current restrictions we are not allowed to exceede a set amount of Small Arms in storage for our Army. However, as was the case during The Civil War, we will use our cunning to hide away our true strength so that Japan will not have any reason to suspect us.
strings.CHI_Begin_Operations_In_Vietnam_desc: The dense jungles of Vietnam leave the door wide open for our agents to coordinate with reble groups in Vietnam should the need arise..
strings.CHI_Industry_Resources_desc: China is a land full of mineral and human resources, waiting to be exploited by industrial means. To further accelerate the sluggish industrialization of the Middle Kingdom, we can funnel a good amount of our National Budget into both state-owned and private enterprises.
strings.CHI_General_Civ_Industry_desc: A sizable portion of the country's industrial sector rests within the hand of the Republican Government. We can use some of our Liquid Reserves to further expand our industrial capacities.
strings.CHI_General_Civ_Industry_trigger_tt_1: Has at least 300M$ in Liquid Reserves
strings.CHI_General_Civ_Industry_trigger_tt_2: National Debt does not exceed Gross Domestic Product
strings.CHI_Additional_Civ_Industry_desc: Our country is industrializing faster and faster, and yet there is still much room for improvement. Aggressive investments from the state should alleviate this issue.

strings.CHI_Additional_Civ_Industry_trigger_tt_2: National Debt does not exceed Gross Domestic Product
strings.CHI_General_Mil_Industry_desc: If we want to build an army to contest the Japanese, we will need a War Machine that can carry the burden of supplying millions of soldiers with weapons and equipment. To this end, we must further increase the output of our military industry. While this will appease the Reformists in the Republican Government, the Japanophiles will certainly not be pleased.

strings.CHI_General_Mil_Industry_trigger_tt_2: National Debt does not exceed Gross Domestic Product
strings.CHI_Invest_Private_Business_desc: Even in a sparsely industrialized country such as ours, there are still plenty private-held industrial companies, ranging from aspiring one-factory dwarves to regional giants. Still, there is still vast room for improvement and expansion, and a few state subsidies have never hurt anyone.

strings.CHI_Divert_Funds_Construction_desc: By diverting funds to provincial construction programs and even some private corporations, we can encourage the continued building of factories, refinieries, and homes. While it will cost us in both political capital and financial capital, this boost could be what our economy needs at the moment.

However, our lack of modern industrial equipment and expertise is bottlenecking our efforts to improve our industrial efficiency even further. We must dedicate some financial capital towards the modernization of both methods and machines if we want to push our industrialization efforts even further.

strings.CHI_Found_Huguang_Metal_Company_desc: The historical region of Huguang stood as a loyal provience of the Ming dynasty, producing scholars and goods for the empire. Although the empire is long dead, the province still has much work to do for China. Authorizing mining operations in the region will surely make our buissnesses more competitive and rake in the profits!

strings.CHI_Found_Huguang_Metal_Company_tt_2: National Debt does not exceed Gross Domestic Product
strings.CHI_Nanjing_Steel_desc: Nanjing's Steel Foundries have the potential to be one of the largest of the Sphere. Now that we have secured a steady supply of hematite ore from the nearby mines and nationalised the steelworks, we can maximise the steel output of Nanjing.

strings.CHI_Create_Hebei_Industrial_Network_desc: Urban planners from across Northern China recently convened at the Beijing Industrial Conference. In one seminar, an engineer proposed the Hebei Industrial Network, or the Northern String of Pearls. An industrial complex visibe from space, the complex would result in the creation of large factories just west of Tianjin. These factories would be accompanied by the migration of millions of agricultural workers and recent secondary school from Beijing. The largest provincial housing program in Chinese history would only be a small part of the Hebei Complex. Along with refinieries, synthetic oil producers, consumer goods shops, and a small arsenal. If completed, Hebei will be the pride of Northern China, something for Manchukuo to marvel at right across the border!

strings.CHI_Resource_Exploitation_desc: It is an open secret that China's primary role in the sphere is to serve as Japan's mineral mine and breadbasket. While the Five Modernisations Program will help to cast off this reputation, increasing the efficiency of our mining operations will still bring great benefits to us, both in the short as in the long term.
strings.CHI_Geological_Survey_desc: The historical lack of industrialization has left China with plenty of untapped mineral deposits, waiting to be discovered and exploited. We should commission National Geological Surveys to find the location of these deposits.

strings.CHI_exploit_changde_desc: Necessary minerals for a modern economy are becoming increasingly rare, but Changde is rich in the resources we need. Iron and coal from the area can be easy mined and sold on the world market with a simply nudge in that direction.

strings.CHI_exploit_fujian_desc: Fujian does not only house the minerals we need, under its rocky terrain are also minerals found exclusively in China, Nanpingite and Chiluite.

strings.CHI_exploit_shanxi_desc: Shanxi has always been an area of interest for mineral extraction companies in China and the area's large reserves of coal give them good reason to. We would be wise to tap into the resources to power our nation and heat our homes.

strings.CHI_CountryInfo_Content_desc.1:
For as long as there has been land, there has been a struggle for China to dominate and exploit it. For centuries, the elite warriors of the Middle Kingdom struck fear into hearts of kings of yore. Even when fractured, the spirit of the people could never be broken, for as the moon waxes and wanes, so does China. Chinese power is an inevitability.

Or so they thought.
strings.CHI_CountryInfo_Content_desc.2:
How cruel fate is to punish a people for prospering. It started small, with squabbling and disagreements in the administration, and then came the arrival of the Western Powers. Capitalizing on the Qing Dynasty's technological disadvantage, coastal China became peppered with Western concessions. Sovereignty was ripped away from China like pulled teeth, agonizingly slow and bloody.

The Japanese Empire was lucky enough to be spared from the horrors of imperialism, but yet had to bear witness to it for so long, watching as her brothers and sisters of Asia were rendered nothing more than workshops for the rest of the world. Japan undertook a grand crusade that fateful day in July of 1937, using its modern technology to bring the imperialists down to the level of their slaves.
strings.CHI_CountryInfo_Content_desc.3: It was this modern advantage that caught the eye of a young Gao Zongwu, who saw this as the leverage that turned the tide of war in favor of the people of Asia. Following the death of the former President of the Republic and his mentor, Wang Jingwei, Gao Zongwu found himself ripped out of his quiet early retirement and back at the centre of the political scene. Gao has outlined his flagship polices that he believes will carry China into the modern age as the Five Modernizations. Calling for an overhauled education system, an expanded industrial sector, an export-based economy, and more, Gao promises a lot, but it remains to be seen if his programs will be a step towards the future or if China has been shattered for the last time.
strings.CHI_CountryInfo_Content_desc.4:
- Sway the Yuan in your favor and exploit the support of your most trusted faction!

- Follow the journey of an ancient nation in a modern world!

- Guide a moderate modernization or charge full speed ahead towards the future!

strings.CHI_WI_counter_NPA_propanganda_desc: Those foolish warmongers knows nothing - what they're doing will lead us to another War with Japan, war that would have crushed China two decades ago had President Wang didn't come to cooperate with the Japanese to preserve the last seeds of Dr. Sun's ideals. Everyone should see the truth that our plans are the only path to a prosperitious, strong China - let people understand who they should fight for.
strings.CHI_WI_more_counter_NPA_propanganda_desc: While our Modernizations benefit everyone in long-term, there will always be some unfortunate short-term sacrifices before we can reap the fruits. Right now, more and more misguided ones who get bemuddled by the fake words of 'fairness', 'independence', 'justice' are secretly approaching the warmongers and wish to see our demise. This musn't be allowed, we shall fund the CBIS more to support the agents in destroying the network NPA has tried to build up, and without theose traitors standing in our way the war will be more in our favor.
